extractionMethod.note: Read via pdftotext -layout, page by page (checked line counts per page first to identify which of the 18 pages were text-bearing rate/policy tables vs photo pages). Rate tables on pages 4-5 (0-indexed) were dense and read directly.

structuralFindings: IMPORTANT RESTRICTION: 'NO BED AND BREAKFAST RATES DURING EASTER AND PEAK SEASON, HALF BOARD OR FULL BOARD RATES ONLY!' — stated explicitly on both the Rack and STO rate tables. BB is simply not offered as a base meal plan during Easter (3-6 Apr) or Peak/Festive (23 Dec-3 Jan) — flag this if a quote requests BB during those dates.

Seven pricing periods (not counting the BB-excluded Easter/Peak rows for BB): High (appears 3 separate times across the year at the same rate), Low, Shoulder (x2), Easter (HB/FB only), Peak (HB/FB only) — a more granular calendar than most properties in this batch, but High/Shoulder repeat at the same rate whenever they recur.

Four room/suite categories: Standard, Superior, Club Room (SGL or DBL flat), Executive & Club Suite (SGL or DBL flat) — Club Room and Executive/Club Suite are priced FLAT regardless of single or double occupancy, unlike Standard/Superior which have distinct single/double columns.

STO tier here is labeled '25% OFF RACK' explicitly in its own table header — confirmed arithmetically exact across every cell checked (e.g. Rack BB High Single $230 x 0.75 = $172.50, rounds to STO $173).

Club Rooms and the Beach Club area are STRICTLY ADULTS ONLY — infants/children are not permitted in Club Rooms, Club Suites, or the Beach Club at all. This is a hard occupancy restriction, not just a pricing note.

Executive Suite and Club Suite carry an extensive list of complimentary/discounted perks (early check-in/late check-out, private dinner every 4 nights, daily high tea, laundry, Beach Club access, spa/shop discounts) — captured below since they materially affect what's 'included' in a quote at that category.
The hotel EXPLICITLY has no direct ocean-facing rooms ('The hotel does not have any direct ocean facing rooms') — worth flagging proactively to a beach-focused client.

A hard blackout-date calendar exists for 2026/Jan 2027 (see blackoutDates below) — Sunworld/agents cannot book on these specific dates regardless of rate tier; check before confirming any date near these windows.

Best Available Rate policy: if the agent finds a cheaper publicly-bookable rate online with identical inclusions, the hotel will match it and pay the agent a 10% commission (screenshot proof required) — a notable commercial term for Sunworld's own booking practice.

Explicit anti-rollover clause: '2025 rates are not to be used for 2026 sales / 2026 rates are not to be used for 2027 sales' — the hotel itself flags against exactly the kind of year-boundary rate misuse this project's CLAUDE.md warns about.

childPolicy.restriction: Infants and children NOT allowed in Club Rooms, Club Suites, or the Beach Club.
childPolicy.age0to3: Free of charge in bed of parents; baby cots available on request/confirmation only (20 available hotel-wide)
childPolicy.age4to11: USD 50 on BB, USD 65 on HB, USD 80 on FB — Superior Category or Executive Suites ONLY (not available in Standard/Club)

childPolicy.note: Children up to 11 years are not allowed to book their own separate room.

extraPersonPolicy.note: No room accommodates 3 adults; no extra beds available at all. If a single-booked room gets an unexpected overnight guest, the rate reverts to the double room rate for that category/meal plan.

maxRoomOccupancy.executiveSuite: 2 adults + 2 children (4-11) + 1 infant (bed of parents or cot)

10% discount at Swahili Shop (not combinable with Wednesday Shopping Experience)
